script:
The Quiz with Balls is an American game show that premiered on May 28, 2024, on Fox.
That is not a guess – it is what the science actually says.
The series is produced by Talpa Studios and Eureka Productions which is a division of Fremantle, and is hosted by Jay Pharoah.
Contestants must answer pop culture and general knowledge questions correctly, or else incorrect answers will result in contestants being pushed into a giant pool of water by large size balls.
And that is the real story of 11 Adults vs General Knowledge Quiz.
